clips.send: A huge population. About 1.41 billion people (2020 census). China is one of the most populous countries in the world: about 1.41 billion people in the 31 provinces, regions and municipalities (2020). Average density is about 147 people per square kilometers , but it differs hugely from place to place. Growth has slowed. New challenges include an ageing population; birth policies keep being improved (e.g. the three-child policy, 2021). Many people, a big base: dense in the southeast, sparse in the northwest.

clips.send: Water resources. Uneven in space and time. Total water resources are among the largest in the world, but water per person is only about one quarter of the world average. Space: more in the south and east, less in the north and west. The north has much farmland but little water. Time: more in summer and autumn, less in winter and spring; big changes between years. Fix space with diversion projects, time with reservoirs. Uneven in space, divert water; uneven in time, build reservoirs.

clips.send: Heihe–Tengchong Line. Dense southeast, sparse northwest. Proposed by geographer Hu Huanyong in 1935, so it is also called the Hu Line. Southeast of the line: about 43 percent of the land but about 94 percent of the people. Northwest: about 57 percent of the land, only about 6 percent of the people (approx.). The southeast is lower and flatter, with a wetter climate, a long history of farming, good transport and a strong economy. The northwest has plateaus, mountains and deserts, and is dry or very cold. Draw a line from Heihe to Tengchong: crowded southeast, empty northwest.

clips.send: 土地资源。 类型齐全，人均耕地少。 耕地主要分布在东部季风区的平原和盆地（东北平原、华北平原、长江中下游平原、四川盆地）。 林地主要分布在东北和西南的山区；草地主要分布在西部（内蒙古、新疆、青海、西藏）；沙漠、戈壁、高寒荒漠等难利用土地比重大。 人均耕地不到世界人均水平的一半。基本国策：十分珍惜、合理利用土地和切实保护耕地。 东耕西牧：东部耕地林地多，西部草地多。

clips.send: 黑河、腾冲线。 东南多，西北少。 1935 年由地理学家胡焕庸提出，所以也叫“胡焕庸线”。 线的东南侧：面积约占全国 百分之43，人口约占 百分之94；西北侧：面积约占 百分之57，人口只占约 百分之6（约数）。 东南部地势较低平、气候湿润、开发历史悠久、交通便利、经济发达；西北部多高原、山地和荒漠，气候干旱或高寒。 黑河到腾冲画一线，东南人多西北稀。
